rationale: CRITICAL: Description: face the wall and lean FORWARD to rest forehead. Under CORRECTED convention (spine + = forward lean, globalTilt + = prone/forward), current config has spine=-22 (backward arch) + globalTilt=-35 (supine tilt) — both WRONG DIRECTION (figure leans backward, head goes to z=-0.739 away from wall-in-front). PR-v3 spine sign misfire: pose was flipped from +22 to -22 based on back-arch wording, but description requires forward lean (spine +). Fix: spine -22→+55 (forward fold, head moves to +z), globalTilt -35→0 (remove backward tilt, spine alone provides forward fold). Reduced shoulder abduction 60/72→60/60 (arms more horizontal, palms at shoulder height). Adjusted shoulderFwd -35/-35→-25/-25 (arms forward in body-frame to wall). Adjusted elbows 45/25→60/60 (moderate bend). Adjusted leftHip/rightHip -20/-10→-15/-15 (legs slightly extended back). Result: head_z -0.739→+0.655 (✓ forehead forward at wall), shoulder_z -0.538→+0.459 (✓ shoulders forward at wall), wrist_z 0.058/-0.024→+0.485/+0.485 (✓ palms at wall), wrist_y 0.721/0.843→0.483 (✓ at shoulder height 0.441), hip_z -0.069→0.000 (✓ hips pushed back relative to forward-leaning upper body).
